neighbours.label: the word-initial piece ' ac' / ' Ac' at the start of a split word (acolyte, acquires, acoustics, Acrobatics)
fire: The hall was designed with careful attention to its acoustics.
Over the years the old merchant acquired a taste for fine wine.
The circus show ended with a stunning display of acrobatics.
The priest walked in, followed closely by a young acolyte.
Her speech had a slight regional accent that I could not place.
The engineers measured the acoustic response of the new room.
The museum recently acquired three paintings from a private collector.
Visitors loved the acrobats who performed above the crowd.
quiet: The hall was designed with careful attention to its lighting.
Over the years the old merchant developed a taste for fine wine.
The circus show ended with a stunning display of juggling.
The priest walked in, followed closely by a young assistant.
Her speech had a slight regional lilt that I could not place.
The engineers measured the thermal response of the new room.
The museum recently bought three paintings from a private collector.
Visitors loved the jugglers who performed above the crowd.

notes: Peak tokens ' ac' x6, ' Ac' x6, Cyrillic ' ак'. Some of these words may be single tokens (accent, acquired); the label is the split piece.
